info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Sandal Syrup Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Sandal Syrup Catalog Management API allows businesses to create and manage detailed entries for sandal syrup products in their inventory. This endpoint is designed for users who need to add new products to their catalog, including attributes such as product specifications, pricing, and availability. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms and product management teams looking to enhance their offering with nuanced product details. By utilizing this API, users can streamline the onboarding of sandal syrup products into their systems efficiently.
